user.title: Set up QuizRooms
user.description: QuizRooms hosts local-first, multi-room confidence-wagering trivia on your Home Assistant instance. By default, guest play and TV dashboards are restricted to your local network only.

data.custom_lan_base_url: Custom LAN Base URL for QR codes (optional)

data_description.allow_external_access: 🔴 NOT RECOMMENDED: Exposes unauthenticated player, TV, and WebSocket endpoints outside your LAN and disables Smart-Home Stage Effects & HA Events. Keep OFF and whitelist specific VPN/VLAN CIDRs below instead.
data_description.allowed_subnets: Type one CIDR subnet at a time (e.g., 100.64.0.0/10) and press Enter to add it. Click × on any chip to remove it.

confirm_external.title: ⚠️ Security Warning — External Access
confirm_external.description:
Enabling external access is NOT recommended. Anyone who can reach your Home Assistant URL over the internet will be able to open /quizrooms/play and /quizrooms/tv without logging in, and Smart-Home Stage Effects & HA Events will be automatically disabled.

For VPN/VLAN access (e.g., Tailscale or WireGuard), close this dialog, keep External Access OFF, and add only your VPN CIDR under Additional Allowed IP Subnets.

data.confirm_external_access: I understand the risks and want to enable external (non-LAN) access

error.invalid_subnet: One or more CIDR subnets are invalid (example: 192.168.1.0/24 or 100.64.0.0/10). Remove the invalid chip with × and try again.
error.invalid_url: Custom LAN Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.external_access_warning: NOT RECOMMENDED: Enabling external (non-LAN) access exposes unauthenticated guest endpoints outside your local network and disables Stage Effects & HA Events.
error.must_confirm_external: Check the confirmation box below to enable external access, or close this dialog to keep LAN-only protection.
